record.what_it_does: Hosted REST API and MCP server for YouTube transcripts, search, channel and playlist data.
record.auth_notes: The REST API (base URL https://transcriptapi.com/api/v2) accepts only an API key, sent as "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY". Keys are created in the dashboard. OAuth 2.1 exists only on the hosted MCP server, for the Claude and ChatGPT connectors. The REST docs do not offer OAuth to third-party apps. Each end user would supply their own key.
record.access_notes: Signup gives 100 free credits and needs no card. The monthly plan is $5/month for 1,000 credits, with top-ups at $2.50 per 1K. The annual plan is $54/year, with top-ups at $1.50 per 1K. Rate limits are 200 RPM on monthly and 300 RPM on annual. Some endpoints cost no credits: info, channel/resolve and channel/latest.
record.api_breadth_notes:
13 read-only GET endpoints:
- /youtube/transcript
- /youtube/info
- /youtube/video/metadata
- /youtube/search
- /youtube/channel/resolve, info, search, videos, playlists, posts, sections, latest
- /youtube/playlist/videos

The MCP server exposes 12 tools. The count sits at the low end of "moderate", and the API offers no write operations.
record.mcp_notes: The vendor hosts the server at https://transcriptapi.com/mcp. It takes OAuth 2.1 (Claude, ChatGPT) or an API key sent as a Bearer token, and exposes 12 tools, including get_youtube_transcript and search_youtube.
record.blocker_notes: The API is small, read-only and billed per credit. The 100 free credits cover development. A public OpenAPI 3.1 spec is published at /openapi.json.

evidence.quote: The API uses Bearer token authentication.

OAuth 2.1 (Claude, ChatGPT) or an API key sent as a Bearer token (OpenAI Agent Builder and other clients).
claude mcp add --transport http transcript-api https://transcriptapi.com/mcp
